EstmtEnergyUseJobRun.name: EstmtEnergyUseJobRun
EstmtEnergyUseJobRun.description: Represents an instance of running the criteria applied to generate the estimated energy use records.

EstmtEnergyUseCriteriaId.description: The estimated energy use criteria related to this estimated energy use criteria run instance record.

FailedRecords.description: Number of records that were failed to create in the run

FromDate.description: The start date of the missing data.

JobId.description: The job ID used to monitor and view details of the data records created.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.

SuccessRecords.description: Number of records that are created successfully in the run

ToDate.description: The end date of the missing data.
